difference: The candidate is 56 bytes and includes PACIASP/AUTIASP plus explicit zero argument moves; the Ghidra stock body is 44 bytes.
limitations: The original stock ELF bytes are unavailable, so exact instruction count and byte identity cannot be established beyond the preserved Ghidra body length and P-Code order.
The Ghidra pseudocode omits the explicit argument values at the zte_touch_deinit call site; the reconstructed source passes three zero values as required by its recovered prototype.
